narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two wrestlers gained and only one lost, so the mean goes up.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>The loss is two kilograms. The two gains are one kilogram each.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Counting people is not enough, because the amounts matter. The bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble says two gained, one lost, so the mean goes up; the changes −2, +1, +1 appear with a total of 0; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='add'/>To check a mean, add all the changes. Zero means no change.
<bookmark mark='mid'/>To check a median, ask who sits in the middle of the sorted list.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines appear: add the changes, test who sits in the middle

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says two gained and only one lost, so the mean goes up. The changes add to zero, so the total and the mean stay the same, and the bubble is struck.
